limitations.text: Findings are based on respondents from only 11 markets, so conclusions may not generalize to youth in unstudied regions.

The executive summary does not describe sample size, data-collection tools or analytic methods, limiting the ability to judge the reliability of headline statistics such as the 83% and 72% figures that are presented.
The report is produced by a consultancy that advertises paid workshops and a full report, introducing possible promotional bias in how results are framed.
Sweeping claims about permanent identity contradictions are asserted without accompanying quantitative evidence or referenced studies.
